<function name="GetCreationID" parent="Entity" type="classfunc">
	<description>Returns entity's creation ID. Unlike <page>Entity:EntIndex</page> or <page>Entity:MapCreationID</page>.

It will increase up until value of `10 000 000`, at which point it will reset back to `0`.
<bug>This returns `0` for clientside only entities, such as `class CLuaEffect`.</bug>
</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="number">The creation ID</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
